title: The cost of Nigeria’s power failures for one small business
html:
The cost of Nigeria’s power failures for one small business

Fashion business owner Aderayo Soile says unreliable electricity is holding back her business. Despite paying for the country’s highest electricity supply tier, she has to buy fuel for a generator to keep operating and wants the next president to make reliable power a priority.
summary: Fashion business owner Aderayo Soile says unreliable electricity is holding back her business.
